name: BRELOK -ねずみたちの脱出-
detailed_description:
You wake up in a strange room.
A phone falls in front of you.
A strange voice comes from the phone.
Check your surroundings and tell the other person what you found out!

*What kind of game is it?
Each player chooses a different character.
Each character seems to be in a different room, and in order to escape from this place, they may need to communicate information that only each other can see.
Let's cooperate, converse with each other, and solve the mystery.

Overview.

“BRELOK - Escape of the mice” is a cooperative puzzle-solving escape game exclusively for two players.

Both players need to own the game and communicate with each other via Discord or other communication tools.

Number of players
2 players

Playing time
30 minutes to 1 hour

Notes

We welcome both individuals and corporations to distribute gameplay videos, but please be sure to read the following guidelines.

Please include the URL of the store page in the summary section or other places that viewers can access.
Monetization through functions provided by the video site (advertisement revenue, money pitches, etc.) is permitted.
Live game distribution that contains slanderous content or content offensive to public order and morals is prohibited.
Hiromenten will not be held responsible for any damages or problems that may occur through live game distribution.
The hashtag for Twitter (X) should be #BRELOK.
Fan art and derivative works are welcome.
However, when talking about stories that contain fatal spoilers on social networking sites, please use the hashtag “#BRELOK”.
These terms and conditions are subject to change without notice, and any videos made after the change will be subject to the new terms and conditions.
